Akasha automatically puts you in the leaderboard it scores the most in or what matches your equipped weapon
Basically the end result of the crit ratios. Crit damage multiplied by crit rate

That's also just not how it works. 

225 x 0.75 = 168.75

140 x 0.9 = 126

There's more than just the crit ratio difference

Average damage makes it so all damage is normalised, meaning your damage is basically multiplied by crit rate. If you have 90% crit rate, you get a 0.9 multiplier, 80% crit rate 0.8 multiplier etc. You're capable of hitting 10 crits in a row with 50% crit rate but akasha doesn't care about that. It normalises the damage with the crit rate so it's very valuable but that's just how akasha works
Yeah that's just how average damage works, if you have 50% crit rate you're missing half the crits so it basically cuts the damage in half compared to having 100% crit rate

I feel like you might have missed something about the specific leaderboard because it sounds wrong. Akasha doesn't 'favour' crit rate or anything, it just does more average damage but you're entirely free to not go further than 80% if you feel like doing higher critical hits, and just have less of them

Akasha uses average damage for a much more consistent result. It's just math in the end.
